text: dsh-answer-me-with-html 是 DeepSeek Harness 的可选技能插件：把复杂回答整理成单页 HTML 讲解。它通过专用技能文件系统 provider 加载随包附带的技能；模型写 Markdown 草稿，am 命令行工具负责页面布局、主题和图表渲染。技能可按需为流程、比较、诊断等内容生成页面，也支持把讲解稿制作成视频并配置旁白。适合需要图示说明或可分享讲解页的 DSH 用户。旁白可用系统语音、本地服务或 ElevenLabs；启用 ElevenLabs 时会发送旁白文本并需要 API key。

dsh-answer-me-with-html is an opt-in DSH skill for turning complex answers into themed, single-page HTML explainers. Its bundled am CLI renders Markdown drafts with diagrams and tables, and can make narrated explainer videos. Video voice can use system TTS, a local service, or ElevenLabs.
想把复杂问题的解释整理成带图表的单页网页。
我有一份讲解草稿，想生成带旁白的说明视频。
Can I turn a Markdown explanation into a styled HTML page with diagrams?
dsh-answer-me-with-html 的功能「单页讲解」：把 Markdown 草稿排成主题化 HTML 页面，并渲染流程图、表格等组件。用户提交复杂解释或比较请求后按技能规则生成；页面保存到本地。
dsh-answer-me-with-html 的功能「讲解视频」：将分场景的讲解稿渲染成带字幕的网页视频，可选择旁白语音。用户提供含场景和旁白的草稿后调用 am video。
ElevenLabs 会把旁白文本发送至 api.elevenlabs.io 并用 ELEVENLABS_API_KEY 鉴权。（见 skills/answer-me-with-html/scripts/am.mjs:7542-7573）
dsh-answer-me-with-html 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 32 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · dsh-answer-me-with-html：[Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: an
opt-in, skill-only bundle that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read.

The model writes a short Markdown draft; the bundled `am` CLI writes the CSS, the layout and the SVG
diagram coordinates. About 1/8 of the tokens of hand-written HTML.

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · What is in here：| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The only row: a dedicated `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` provider whose single root is `skills/` |
| `skills/answer-me-with-html/` | The upstream skill, vendored verbatim — `SKILL.md`, `references/`, and the dependency-free `scripts/am.mjs` CLI |
| `scripts/update-skill.sh` | Re-vendors the folder above from upstream and checks it (`npm test`) |
| `scripts/publish-to-npm.sh` | Logs in if needed, then publishes this package to npm |

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · What is in here：There is no Host code. The skill reaches the session catalog through the bundled skill root, so nothing
is copied into `~/.dsh/skills` and no other profile is affected.

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · Install：From npm — no build step, and nothing to authorise:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-answer-me-with-html
```

Or from a clone, which is how this repository is used for development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-answer-me-with-html
```

Or install it from the plugin market / settings UI by pointing at the same directory.

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · Install：Installing from the git URL also works, but `dsh plugin add` needs `pnpm` on your `PATH` for that, and
GitHub's tarball has no build step to run either way.

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · Requirements：- Node.js 20+ (the `am` CLI runs as `node <skill dir>/scripts/am.mjs`; no `npm install` step).
- Pages are written to `~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/`.

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · Use：Ask a question the way you always do. The skill decides when a page is worth it:

> Explain the TCP three-way handshake
> Redis or Memcached for our cache?

The skill name is `answer-me-with-html`, and DSH passes its own base directory into the loaded skill, so
the `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` placeholders in `SKILL.md` need no edit.

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · Use：> **One trap:** if you also enable the default `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` provider, it scans
> `~/.dsh/skills` and `~/.agents/skills` at a higher rank than this bundle's root. An older copy of this
> skill left in either directory then shadows this one — a stale copy, silently.
>
> Before deleting that copy, check what else points at it:
>
> ```bash
> ls -la ~/.dsh/skills ~/.agents/skills ~/.claude/skills 2>/dev/null | grep answer-me-with-html
> ```
>
> `~/.agents/skills/answer-me-with-html` is often the real copy for other agents (Claude Code, ZCode,
> Hermes and WorkBuddy typically symlink to it), so deleting it breaks those. Either leave the default
> provider off — it is off unless something enables it — or update the shared copy too instead of
> removing it.

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · Updating the skill：`skills/answer-me-with-html/` is a verbatim copy of the upstream `skills/answer-me-with-html` folder, so an
update is a copy and not a merge:

```bash
scripts/update-skill.sh
```

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · Updating the skill：It clones upstream, and if the copy already matches, says so and exits without touching anything.
Otherwise it re-copies the folder, moves `package.json`'s version to the vendored CLI's version, and runs
the tests. It prints the upstream commit — put that hash in the commit message, because upstream has
shipped code changes without a version bump, and the hash is what identifies the vendored state.

dsh-answer-me-with-html README · Updating the skill：> **The CLI's own update hint is wrong here.** After a week `am render` may print
> `! Update hint: Answer me with HTML <v> is available ... run npx skills update answer-me-with-html -y`.
> That command belongs to [vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) and updates a copy
> in `~/.agents/skills` — never the copy this plugin serves. It cannot update this plugin; run
> `scripts/update-skill.sh` in this repository instead. Upstream has no DeepSeek Harness branch for this
> (checked in 0.5.0), so the hint keeps saying it.
